messages:
Diego: Hey all, remote first day! Quick question: I have view access to Notion but not edit. Where do folks keep onboarding checklists and team templates now? I found an old 'Templates' page but it looks deprecated.
Mei: Welcome Diego :wave: We moved the canonical stuff into Knowledge Base -> Docs Kit last quarter. The old Templates page is kept for archive but new templates live under Docs Kit / Templates.
Diego: Gotcha. I can't see Docs Kit. Is that a permissions thing or a different workspace?
Devex Bot: Tip: Docs Kit is in the same workspace but gated by the SSO group "eng-read" for viewing and "eng-edit" for editing. If you need edit rights, submit the Request Docs Access form: https://forms.redwood.internal/docs-access and include the page URL and desired role.
Diego: If I duplicate a template can I keep the edit history linked somehow? I want to keep traceability for onboarding checklist changes.
Mei: Duplicate into your Team space works. For traceability we encourage two things: 1) add a migration tag at top (e.g., "doc-migration:v2") and 2) open a comment on the original template with the link to your copy. We also track major template changes in the docs-metadata repo (tiny PR with the page URL) so Platform knows about schema updates.
Rakesh: I own the Service Onboarding checklist. If you're updating it for a new service, DM me and I'll add you as an editor rather than you editing the canonical page. We prefer edits via a review comment first.
Diego: Thanks @Rakesh. Any naming rules for copies? I don't want to create duplicates that are hard to find later.
Mei: We use: "Team / Service - DocType - ShortTitle" e.g., "Platform / EventBus - Onboarding - Initial Setup". Add properties: Owner, TemplateVersion, Status(draft|ready|stable), and a Tag for "onboarding".
Diego: Smooth. One last thing: is there a slack workflow to request page watchers so I get notified of only major updates?
Devex Bot: Use the page top-right menu -> Watch -> choose "Major updates only". For cross-team visibility add yourself as a reviewer in the page properties to reduce noise. If you prefer, run: /watch-page <page-url> and Devex will set it for you (internal slash commands available).
Diego: Perfect. Submitted the access form and pinged @Rakesh. Appreciate the quick help!
Mei: Welcome aboard Diego. If you want, I can walk you through Docs Kit templates later today.
Rakesh: Happy to pair for 10m after lunch to go over the onboarding checklist structure.
